text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Compare revenue (order subtotal) per store location this year versus last year and show the change, so the user can see where revenue fell; the project has no \"region\" (locations are the nearest grain) and cannot itself answer \"why\" or recommend where to invest.","measures":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","aggregation":"sum","alias":"revenue_last_year","scope":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["last_year"],"source":"question"}]},{"ref":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","aggregation":"sum","alias":"revenue_this_year","scope":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","op":"eq","values":["this_year"],"source":"question"}]},{"change":{"base":"revenue_last_year","comparison":"revenue_this_year","as":"percent"},"alias":"revenue_change_pct"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.location_id","role":"key"}],"display":["column:dev.locations.location_name"],"filters":[],"ordering":{"ref":"revenue_change_pct","direction":"asc"},"expectedShape":"comparison","unresolved":[{"clause":"revenue","options":["column:dev.orders.subtotal","column:dev.orders.order_total"],"material":true,"question":"Should revenue be the pretax order subtotal or the order total including tax?"},{"clause":"by region","options":["column:dev.orders.location_id"],"material":false,"question":"The project has no region; store location is used as the regional grain."},{"clause":"why is revenue down / which region should we invest in","options":[],"material":false,"question":"Causes and investment recommendations are not held in the data; the comparison shows where revenue changed, and the judgment is yours."}],"provenance":{"column:dev.orders.subtotal":"q:revenue","column:dev.orders.ordered_at":"q:down","column:dev.orders.location_id":"q:by region","column:dev.locations.location_name":"q:by region"}}
